_comment: Copy this file to paths.json and edit for your machine. paths.json is gitignored because it is machine specific.
_includePathComment: MQL5 folder that contains Include\. MetaEditor resolves <Trade\Trade.mqh> against its own data folder, not against your source folder, so this must be set explicitly. Find it in MetaTrader: File, Open Data Folder.
_portableComment: Recommended: point terminal, dataFolder and includePath at a second, backtest-only copy of MetaTrader run with /portable (for example C:\MT5-Backtest, with dataFolder the same folder) and set portable to true. backtest.ps1 then never needs the live terminal closed. See note 11 in scripts\backtest.ps1.
